annotations.title: Check a website for security issues

description: Use this when the person wants a public website checked for security problems, for example "is my site secure?" or "check example.com". Free and read-only: HTTPS, security headers, cookie flags and exposed keys, with a grade from A+ to F and how to fix each finding. Not a pentest. Do not use for private or local addresses or for code repositories (use scan_repo).

language.description: The language the person is writing in, as a BCP 47 tag such as "ru".

url.description: The public address to check, for example https://example.com

name: scan_url
title: Check a website for security issues
